summary: Verified the 5-criterion condition-edit/re-price acceptance matrix (condition-only edit suppresses the guide line, Re-price from condition recomputes & restores it, manual price edit suppresses it, all 7 condition grades selectable/persist, and edits survive reload + propagate to the inventory grid) with new backend test file + 5 new named browser checks, plus one re-run through the public preview URL. All 5 criteria passed on both lanes where applicable; no application bugs found.
action_items: Pre-existing, out-of-scope test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py has 2 failures unrelated to this iteration's matrix: (1) anonymous POST /api/appraise now returns 401 instead of the test's expected 403 (CSRF-guard-vs-auth-order likely changed in a prior unrelated change), (2) missing fixture image at /tmp/item.jpg. Neither touches condition/price_source/edit-dialog behavior; left unmodified per scope, flagging for a future iteration.

checks.criterion: Backend: condition-only PATCH leaves recommended_price and price_source untouched
checks.name: tests/test_tscheck_condition_edit_pricing.py::test_condition_only_edit_does_not_touch_price_or_source
checks.evidence: POST /api/inventory -> 201 {recommended_price:20.0, price_source:'charity'}; PATCH {condition:'Fair'} -> 200 {condition:'Fair', recommended_price:20.0, price_source:'charity'} unchanged

checks.criterion: Condition-only edit does not leave a misleading guide line on the tag
checks.name: condition-only-edit-no-misleading-guide-line
checks.evidence: Created tscheck item (peak 100, avg 40, Good/34/charity) via API, opened /tag/{id} -> tag-condition showed 'priced at 85% of guide'. Edit dialog: changed Condition to Fair WITHOUT tapping Re-price, Save. tag-condition now contains 'Fair' with no 'priced at ... of guide' text; tag-price unchanged (£34.00 before and after). Re-ran once more against the public preview URL — passed

checks.criterion: Backend: a Re-price-from-condition-style PATCH (condition + recomputed price + price_source=charity) persists all three fields
checks.name: tests/test_tscheck_condition_edit_pricing.py::test_reprice_from_condition_persists_new_price_and_charity_source
checks.evidence: PATCH {condition:'Fair', recommended_price:26.0, price_source:'charity'} -> 200 {condition:'Fair', recommended_price:26.0, price_source:'charity'} (guide base round(min(40,50)*2)/2=40, 40*0.65 rounded to 50p = 26, matching frontend charityGuidePrice/adjustedCharityPrice formula)

checks.criterion: Re-price from condition recomputes the price and restores the guide line
checks.name: reprice-from-condition-restores-guide-line
checks.evidence: Same fixture item; opened Edit, selected Fair, tapped reprice-from-condition -> edit-price-input changed from '34' to '26' (matches the 65% Fair multiplier of the 40 guide base). Saved -> tag-condition shows 'priced at 65% of guide', tag-price shows '26'

checks.criterion: Backend: manual price PATCH with price_source=custom persists as custom
checks.name: tests/test_tscheck_condition_edit_pricing.py::test_manual_price_edit_sets_custom_source

checks.criterion: Manual price edit suppresses the guide line
checks.name: manual-price-edit-suppresses-guide-line
checks.evidence: Opened Edit on fixture item, typed '19.50' directly into edit-price-input (no condition change), Save. tag-price shows '19.50'; tag-condition text has no 'priced at ... of guide' substring

checks.criterion: Backend: all 7 condition grades accepted/persist; unknown grade rejected
checks.name: tests/test_tscheck_condition_edit_pricing.py::test_all_seven_condition_grades_accepted_and_persist + test_unknown_condition_grade_rejected
checks.evidence: Looped PATCH {condition:g} for all 7 grades -> 200 each, final GET /api/inventory/{id} -> condition:'Poor/for repair'; PATCH {condition:'Mint-ish ish'} -> 422 'Unknown condition'

checks.criterion: Expanded 7-grade condition list is selectable in the edit dialog
checks.name: expanded-condition-list-all-seven-grades-selectable
checks.evidence: Edit dialog Condition dropdown: cycled through all 7 edit-condition-* options (New with tags, New without tags, Excellent, Very good, Good, Fair, Poor/for repair), each selection reflected in the trigger label; Save persisted 'Poor/for repair' in the Item record's Condition row

checks.name: condition-edit-persists-after-reload-and-inventory-grid
checks.evidence: Set condition to 'Very good' and saved; Item record row showed 'Very good'. Hard page.reload() of /tag/{id} -> still shows 'Very good'. Navigated to Inventory via nav-inventory -> inventory-item-{id} card text also contains 'Very good' without a manual refresh (TanStack Query cache invalidated on save)
